maddeler.e:
تكافحت (form VI)
# تَكَافَحْتُ (takāfaḥtu) /ta.kaː.faħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# تَكَافَحْتَ (takāfaḥta) /ta.kaː.faħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# تَكَافَحْتِ (takāfaḥti) /ta.kaː.faħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# تَكَافَحَتْ (takāfaḥat) /ta.kaː.fa.ħat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
